theorems.statement: ∀ (P Q d : ℕ) (L : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid Q) (hL : IsProperMap (fun x => (0 : Euclid Q) + L x)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d), Isometry L → R.Represents T → ∃ R' : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid Q)) d, R'.Represents (GeometricCurrentOn.affinePushforward (V := (univ : Set (Euclid Q))) L 0 hL T) ∧ ∀ s : Set (Euclid Q), MeasurableSet s → R'.measure s = R.measure (L ⁻¹' s)
